basic_details.job_title: East Godavari District Court Head Clerk Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: East Godavari District Court has announced for the Head-Clerk post on a contract basis under recruitment notification Dis.No.10077 dated 12 October 2026. Eligible candidates who have retired as Chief Administrative Officers or Superintendents of A.P. Judicial Ministerial Service must submit the prescribed offline application by hand or post to the District Court, Rajamahendravaram. The last date for submission of applications is 27 October 2026. The notified consolidated remuneration for the Head-Clerk post is Rs. 44,570, and the selection process involves submission of the prescribed applicat

qualification.details: Eligibility Conditions: Only persons who have retired as Chief Administrative Officers or Superintendents of A.P. Judicial Ministerial Service will be considered. Ministerial officers who have retired on attaining the age of superannuation, who are under 65 years of age, and who have a sufficient remaining period of service to work until attaining the age of 65, and who possess a satisfactory record of service are eligible.

selection_process: The appointment of retired judicial employees is subject to verification of service records
production of a medical fitness certificate
and an agreement entered into with the concerned unit head initially for a period of one year.

Rajamahendravaram, East Godavari District, Andhra Pradesh

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications should be submitted directly to the District Court, Rajamahendravaram on or before 27.10.2026 up to 5:00 P.M. using the proforma appended to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Eligibility Conditions: Only persons who have retired as Chief Administrative Officers or Superintendents of A.P. Judicial Ministerial Service will be considered. Ministerial officers who have retired on attaining the age of superannuation, who are under 65 years of age, and who have a sufficient remaining period of service to work until attaining the age of 65, and who possess a satisfactory record of service are eligible.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Prescribed application form Service certificates Medical fitness certificate

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The appointment of retired judicial employees is subject to verification of service records, production of a medical fitness certificate, and an agreement entered into with the concerned unit head initially for a period of one year.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the application for the East Godavari District Court Head-Clerk post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 27 October 2026 up to 5:00 P.M.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible to apply for this Head-Clerk recruitment?
faq.answer: Only persons who have retired as Chief Administrative Officers or Superintendents of A.P. Judicial Ministerial Service with a satisfactory record of service, who are under 65 years of age, and who have sufficient remaining service to work until attaining age 65 are eligible.

faq.question: Q3. Is the Head-Clerk post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The post is on a contract basis in the V Additional District Court (Permanent Fast Track Court), Rajamahendravaram.

faq.question: Q4. What is the monthly remuneration for the Head-Clerk position?
faq.answer: The minimum time scale of the post is Rs. 44,570/- per month, subject to such consolidated remuneration as determined from time to time.

faq.question: Q5. Which documents must be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants should submit their service certificates and a medical fitness certificate along with the prescribed proforma application.
